role: number of event categories
notes: A positive finite category count; not a target mean.

role: category indices
notes: Indices range from one through m.

role: strictly positive target proportions and their vector
notes: A stipulated target law; not the empirical significance p in study summaries.

role: category-conditional exposure admission probability
notes: Weights lie in the unit interval and have positive total selected mass.

role: conditional exposure-record proportions and their vector
notes: An observed record law need not equal the target law.

role: event of admission to the exposure record
notes: An event under the stipulated selection law.

role: positive normalizing scale constructing admissible selection weights
notes: Chosen at most every positive p_i/q_i; no empirical selection parameter is estimated.

role: probability under the declared target and selection law
notes: Target and admitted-record probabilities remain distinct.

role: boy and girl outcome labels for exact birth strings
notes: Labels describe model outcomes rather than demographic frequencies.

role: head and tail outcome labels for exact coin strings
notes: Exact strings are not events specifying only a count of heads.

role: common Bernoulli outcome probability
notes: Birth and coin illustrations each declare their own independent Bernoulli model; p is not a significance level.

role: probability under the stipulated independent birth or coin law
notes: Fair marginal probabilities alone do not establish the product law.

role: fixed number of independently sampled cases
notes: In the birth illustration N is the surveyed-family total; it is not given by the observed count 72.

role: random counts of two disjoint exact-string categories
notes: Equal underlying category probabilities need not yield equal observed counts.

role: probabilities of two disjoint categories
notes: Require zero at most a less than one and a+b at most one.

role: attainable fixed category-count values
notes: Lowercase values distinguish conditioning from the random counts X and Y.

role: expectation under the declared independent-case sampling law
notes: Conditional expectation depends on the fixed sample size N.

role: probability under the declared independent-case sampling law
notes: The multinomial law supplies the conditional binomial calculation.

role: binomial distribution
notes: Zero remaining trials yield a degenerate count of zero.

role: total objects and recognized-object count
notes: N is at least two and zero at most n at most N; not the independent-case sample size in the disjoint count benchmark.

role: conditional accuracy of recognition and knowledge-based choice
notes: Empty pair classes receive arbitrary versions of their conditional parameters with zero weight; comparisons explicitly fix both validities.

role: expected accuracy at recognition amount n
notes: Uniform unordered pair selection weights the three pair classes.

role: reported significance bound and F or t test statistic
notes: Reported inferential statistics retain each source's task and design; p is not a Bernoulli or target-category probability.
